claims.text: Equimolar WTaTiVZr has improved plastic strain relative to pure tungsten at high temperature.
Equimolar WTaTiVZr has improved toughness relative to pure tungsten at high temperature.
Equimolar mixing of W, Ta, Ti, V, and Zr produces lattice distortion.
Lattice distortion is the primary factor governing the alloy's improved plastic strain and toughness.
The lattice distortion lowers the energy barrier for dislocation nucleation and mobility at high temperature.
Lower barriers to dislocation nucleation and motion enhance high-temperature ductility and crack resistance.
Powder metallurgy and hot isostatic pressing can produce equimolar WTaTiVZr with a homogeneous single-phase microstructure.
Equimolar mixing produces a distortion-strengthened microstructure with a greater density and heterogeneity of local stress fields.
The local stress fields produced by equimolar mixing facilitate dislocation motion.
Lattice distortion in WTaTiVZr lowers the Peierls barrier for dislocation glide.
Enhanced high-temperature dislocation mobility reduces the brittle-to-ductile transition temperature.
Enhanced dislocation mobility improves toughness by increasing deformation-energy dissipation and delaying crack initiation and propagation.
WTaTiVZr will exhibit higher plastic strain than pure tungsten between 900°C and 1200°C.
WTaTiVZr will exhibit higher fracture toughness than pure tungsten between 900°C and 1200°C.
WTaTiVZr will have a lower onset temperature for ductile behavior than pure tungsten.
WTaTiVZr will have a lower activation energy for dislocation motion than pure tungsten.
Commercially used high-purity recrystallized tungsten has a higher brittle-to-ductile transition temperature and lower toughness under equivalent conditions.
The proposed mechanism is expected to operate from approximately 900°C to 1200°C, where dislocation mobility is thermally activated.
The proposed mechanism requires a homogeneous single-phase alloy and may not apply at lower temperatures or when substantial secondary-phase segregation occurs.

contradictions.description: The initial state and baseline compare powder-metallurgy/HIP WTaTiVZr with conventionally processed recrystallized tungsten, whereas the intervention says processing is nearly identical and the falsification design requires identical processing routes. These are materially different controls and affect whether composition-induced lattice distortion is isolated.
